name: connect-desktop
author: nightdevx

engines.//: pnpm 11 imports node:sqlite, which only exists from Node 22.13. On anything older the install crashes outright rather than degrading.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on dist/main/index.js dist/preload/index.js tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electronmon --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload . --no-sandbox
scripts.dev:electron:a: wait-on dist/main/index.js dist/preload/index.js tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 CT_USER_DATA_DIR=.profiles/instance-a electronmon --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload . --no-sandbox
scripts.dev:electron:b: wait-on dist/main/index.js dist/preload/index.js tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 CT_USER_DATA_DIR=.profiles/instance-b electronmon --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload . --no-sandbox
scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm build:main && pnpm build:renderer
scripts.check: pnpm build:main && node scripts/check-media-stats.cjs && node scripts/check-video-layers.cjs && node scripts/check-loopback-worklet.cjs
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && pnpm build:native && pnpm clean:release && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && pnpm check:package
scripts.dist:win:publish: pnpm build && pnpm build:native && pnpm clean:release && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always && pnpm check:package
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && pnpm clean:release && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:publish: pnpm build && pnpm clean:release && electron-builder --linux --publish always

//dependencies: electron-builder packs `dependencies` into the asar verbatim and ignores `devDependencies`. Only what the MAIN process requires at runtime belongs here: it is plain tsc output, so its `require`s resolve from node_modules. Everything the renderer imports is bundled by Vite and must NOT be listed here, or a second copy of it ships inside the archive unused.
